item.title: FRINGE: Maho Magic Bar brings its neon lights and Tokyo-style illusions back to Adelaide Fringe
item.description: Cult-favourite Maho Magic Bar is returning to Adelaide Fringe in 2026, promising cocktails, close-up illusion and high-energy Tokyo nightlife in The Garden.

item.title: Australian researchers innovate with peppermint oil coating to fight infections in medical devices
item.description: South Australian scientists have used peppermint oil to create a groundbreaking coating for medical devices, enhancing safety by preventing infections and reducing inflammation while prioritising environmental sustainability.

item.title: Clare Valley Gourmet Festival returns for 2026 with four days of long lunches, live music & curated foodie trails
item.description: The Clare Valley Gourmet Festival is back from May 15th to 18th, bringing more than 45 food, wine and music events to one of South Australia’s most beloved regional destinations.

item.description: A beloved Grenfell Street institution has reopened its doors, with Adelaide Coffee Bar returning after more than two decades.

item.title: COMING SOON: Feed deer, feast on venison & explore the Hills at the new farm-to-table Hahndorf Hirschgarten
item.description: A pioneering new agritourism destination is coming to the Adelaide Hills, with Hahndorf Hirschgarten set to offer hands-on deer encounters, seasonal venison dining and velvet-infused spirits from this autumn.
